entries.zh: 许愿，立誓愿（向神许诺、发愿）；许诺
entries.en: to vow, to make a vow (to God, to a saint); to promise
entries.notes: M 栏「愈」与「許」组合义未明，属特别情况；据 L「voto, hacer voto」与 R「hù guān」（許願）定为许愿义。

entries.en: voice; sound
to shout, to cry out

entries.zh: 呼喝叱声；呸（吐唾斥骂之声）；拂逆
entries.en: angry shout; cry of scorn (spitting sound); to refuse, to contradict
entries.notes: 「咈」字义歧（违逆/叱喝声），据 R「pūi」似为呸唾斥喝之音写，释义存疑。

entries.en: rumor, false report (of a tumult)
entries.notes: R 栏注[疑:pōgō/pōpō]；据 H「訛」与 L「voz」古义『传言』定为骚乱讹传义。

entries.en: clamor, uproar, noise of a tumult
alas!; to sigh, to lament
entries.notes: L「apercebado」词义未明（或指惊惶/哀伤者所发之声），据 H「嗟」定为嗟叹义。

entries.zh: 呼号，呼吁（求救哀告之声）；长叹
entries.en: to cry out, to appeal (plea for help); to sigh
entries.notes: R 栏首音污損難辨（T99），据 H「吁」与 L 语义定为呼号呼吁义，置信降低。

entries.en: cry of terror, wailing, howl
entries.notes: L 注[疑:atemorica/samorica]；H「嘹」疑为「嚎」形近字，据 R「háu」定为嚎哭呼号义。

entries.en: to roar, to howl (of the sea or animals)

entries.zh: 嘶哑之声；水流湍急声；咳嗽声
entries.en: hoarse, rasping voice; rush of water, gurgle; coughing sound
entries.notes: H「嗽」兼咳/漱二义，与 R「hām sīa」（喊声）不尽吻合，释义存疑。

entries.en: voice; sound; (tuned) tone

entries.zh: 呼喝叱声；呸（吐唾斥骂之声）；拂逆
entries.en: angry shout; cry of scorn (spitting sound); to refuse, to contradict
entries.notes: 与第 4 条同字同音（咈/pūi），字义歧，释义存疑。

entries.en: to clamor, to make an uproar, to shout noisily
to clamor, to shout clamorously
to shout aloud, to cry out; a shout
to shout, to cry out
to break one's silence, to open one's voice, to cry out
entries.notes: R 栏首音污損難辨（T99），据 H「開」+M「聲」（开声）定为开口呼喊义。

entries.en: to make a sound, to speak up, to cry out
to cry aloud, to shout at the top of one's voice, to roar loudly
entries.notes: M 栏旁注小字「哮」为疑字；据 R「tuā sīa háu」（大聲哮）定为大声吼叫义。

entries.en: aloud, loudly; loud voice
